build_data2vec_vision_model: build a Data2VecVisionModel from a Data2VecVisionConfig for self-supervised vision pretraining
create_patch_embed: create a PatchEmbed module to convert images into patch embeddings using a convolutional layer
create_attention_with_rel_pos: create an Attention module with optional relative position bias for transformer self-attention
create_transformer_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder with shared relative position bias and stochastic depth for vision tasks
create_block_with_layer_scale: create a Block module with layer scaling, drop path, and MLP for transformer architecture
